title: EN 81-70 accessible lifts
edition: EN 81-70:2021+A1:2022 (official preview and KONE's fact sheet)
notes: Type 2 (1100 × 1400 mm, door 900 mm) is the minimum for new buildings; type 1 only where type 2 cannot fit in an existing building; type 4 where doors are on adjacent walls (not checked yet).

accessible_cars.description: Type 2 car: one wheelchair user and a companion
